title: 2.1.26 Chain Your Ternaries
description: Chain at least two conditional operators to pick from three or more values. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Declare a score
steps.instructions: Create a variable called score and set it to a number from 0 to 100.

steps.title: Chain the ternaries
steps.instructions: Create a variable called rating. Chain at least two ? operators to set rating: 90 or above -> 'Excellent', 70 or above -> 'Good', otherwise -> 'Needs work'. Check the highest cutoff first. Log rating.

requirements.title: at least two ternary operators chained
requirements.description: Code contains two or more ? ...: ternary expressions
